t: 五代名畫補遺 - Chinese Text Project
s: 'Wudai Minghua Buyi' (五代名畫補遺) is a single-volume work compiled by Liu Daochun during the Song Dynasty. The work is a supplement to the 'Liangchao Minghua Lu' (梁朝名畫錄), which was originally written by Hu Jiao. According to Chao Gongwu in his 'Dushu Zhi' (讀書志), 'Wudai Minghua Buyi' was compiled to expand on Hu Jiao's earlier work, hence the title "Supplement" ('Buyi').
